Thanks again -
Curtis

On Thu, Oct 15, 2015 at 11:35 AM, Maria Glymenaki <maria.g...@manchester.ac.uk> wrote:
Dear Dr Huttenhower,

I have been using the MaAsLin tool on Galaxy run by your laboratory and I have a question on the output format of my data.  I used as input my OTU table (normalized per sample and in the format suggested in your website) and as output I get a file of which OTUs are associated with metadata values. The output I get is for example Firmicutes|Clostridia|Clostridiales|Clostridiaceae|s_14.
I have performed 16S sequencing using the Illumina platform and the highest depth I get is genus. I wanted to ask you what the number after the species is. Could you let me know if it is the order in the which the OTU was present in my input data file, as I get many samples of the form Firmicutes|Clostridia|Clostridiales|Clostridiaceae|s_ but they are assigned different numbers at the end of species?

I would like to thank you in advance for your time and assistance.

Yours sincerely,
Maria Glymeanaki

messages.author: 6681ed41d63e766b
messages.subject: Re: MaAsLin Galaxy output data format question
parts:
Hi Maria, 

This format is usually seen in the OTU input file. Maaslin should not add any additional OTU information. 

However if you're unable to confirm this and think it is a Maaslin error, please share your input file, parameters selected and we can try to reproduce the error. 

Best,
